summary: Iteration 5 testing covered: (1) Backend accounting /api/reports/accounting with periods today/month/all returns gross_revenue/part_cost_total/net_margin and net_margin == gross-cost (401 without auth). (2) Ticket part_cost: POST /api/tickets persists part_cost=30, PUT updates to 45, GET confirms, public /api/public/track/{code} excludes part_cost (and pin). (3) Status flow: new states valutazione + attesa_ricambi accepted by PATCH /api/tickets/{id}/status. (4) Chat endpoints: POST /api/tickets/{id}/messages (auth) stores role='lab' + photo_data; GET requires auth (401 unauth). POST /api/public/track/{code}/messages (no auth) sets role='customer' and strips photo_data (always null); GET public lists lab+customer. Backend pytest: 14/14 PASSED (/app/backend/tests/test_iter5.py). Frontend Playwright 19/19 PASSED: admin login, NewTicket part_cost field + real-time margin (€110,00 for 150-40), ticket row created, PrintA4LayoutDialog opens with a4-layout-vertical/horizontal buttons, choosing horizontal injects .print-root-a4 containing .print-a4-horizontal class and sets html.print-mode-a4 before window.print then cleans up after 500ms; vertical choice injects .print-a4 without .print-a4-horizontal. Chat lab: chat-feed/chat-text-input/chat-send/chat-upload-photo all present; text and photo upload (base64) persisted and visible. EditTicketDialog edit-part-cost + edit-margin real-time (€90,00 for 150-60). Reports: period-today/month/all buttons work; acc-gross/acc-cost/acc-margin cards update across periods. Warehouse: btn-print-lowstock adds html.print-mode-lowstock and injects .print-root-lowstock then cleans up. Public Tracking /?track={CODE}: 6-step timeline (in_registro, valutazione, in_lavorazione, attesa_ricambi, pronto, consegnato) all present; public-chat-input + public-chat-send send customer message visible in feed and in GET response; Foto dal Laboratorio section renders uploaded lab photo. Regression: Dashboard loads. Overall: backend 100% (14/14), frontend 100% (19/19).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py accounting_report: for period=='all' the tickets_q is {} (no filter on delivered_at), so repairs_total sums estimate across ALL tickets including non-delivered (in_registro/valutazione/etc.), potentially inflating gross_revenue vs part_cost_total (which is also summed on same set). For 'today'/'month' it correctly filters by delivered_at. Consider also requiring status in ('consegnato', ...) consistently.
TicketMessagesDialog polls /messages every 5s and Tracking.jsx polls every 7s — fine for small scale, but consider SSE/WebSocket when traffic grows.
Tracking.jsx has eslint-disable-next-line without rule name on the useEffect deps; acceptable but noisy.
PrintA4LayoutDialog / TicketMessagesDialog use DialogContent without DialogDescription — a11y warning (same as iter 4 note).
